Some Dehydration (5-10%): 75mL/kg in the first 24 hours in addition to ongoing losses

No Dehydration (<5%): Observe until ongoing losses can definitely be adequately replaced by ORS

Severe Dehydration (>10%): Once circulation is established monitor every 1-2 hours
